activity_email_authorization_attempts_ou.name: activity_email_authorization_attempts_outcome_check
activity_email_authorization_attempts_ou.value:
("activity_email_authorization_attempts"."outcome" = 'pending' and "activity_email_authorization_attempts"."valid_until" is null)
        or ("activity_email_authorization_attempts"."outcome" in ('permitted', 'denied', 'expired') and "activity_email_authorization_attempts"."valid_until" is not null and "activity_email_authorization_attempts"."valid_until" <= "activity_email_authorization_attempts"."expires_at")

activity_email_candidates_assignment_che.name: activity_email_candidates_assignment_check
activity_email_candidates_assignment_che.value:
("activity_email_candidates"."occurrence_id" is null and "activity_email_candidates"."generation" is null and "activity_email_candidates"."settled_at" is null)
        or ("activity_email_candidates"."occurrence_id" is not null and "activity_email_candidates"."generation" is not null and "activity_email_candidates"."generation" >= 1)

activity_email_occurrences_identity_chec.name: activity_email_occurrences_identity_check
activity_email_occurrences_identity_chec.value:
("activity_email_occurrences"."cadence" = 'each' and "activity_email_occurrences"."individual_candidate_id" is not null and "activity_email_occurrences"."local_date" is null and "activity_email_occurrences"."batch_number" is null)
        or ("activity_email_occurrences"."cadence" in ('daily', 'weekly') and "activity_email_occurrences"."individual_candidate_id" is null and "activity_email_occurrences"."local_date" is not null and "activity_email_occurrences"."batch_number" is not null and "activity_email_occurrences"."batch_number" >= 1)

activity_email_occurrences_lease_check.name: activity_email_occurrences_lease_check
activity_email_occurrences_lease_check.value:
"activity_email_occurrences"."state" in ('scheduled', 'superseded', 'completed')
        and ("activity_email_occurrences"."lease_id" is null) = ("activity_email_occurrences"."lease_until" is null)
        and ("activity_email_occurrences"."state" = 'scheduled' or "activity_email_occurrences"."lease_id" is null)

code_email_deliveries_skip_reason_check.name: code_email_deliveries_skip_reason_check
code_email_deliveries_skip_reason_check.value: ("code_email_deliveries"."status" = 'skipped') = ("code_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is not null) and ("code_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is null or "code_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" in ('expired', 'purpose-not-supported'))

invitation_email_deliveries_skip_reason_.name: invitation_email_deliveries_skip_reason_check
invitation_email_deliveries_skip_reason_.value: ("invitation_email_deliveries"."status" = 'skipped') = ("invitation_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is not null) and ("invitation_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is null or "invitation_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" in ('expired', 'superseded'))

security_email_deliveries_template_check.name: security_email_deliveries_template_check
security_email_deliveries_template_check.value: ("security_email_deliveries"."template" is null) = ("security_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is not distinct from 'change-not-supported') and ("security_email_deliveries"."template" is null or "security_email_deliveries"."template" in ('password-reset', 'password-changed', 'email-changed', 'new-device', 'deletion-scheduled', 'deletion-cancelled', 'two-step-enabled', 'two-step-disabled', 'authenticator-app-replaced', 'backup-codes-regenerated', 'security-key-added', 'security-key-removed'))

security_email_deliveries_skip_reason_ch.name: security_email_deliveries_skip_reason_check
security_email_deliveries_skip_reason_ch.value: ("security_email_deliveries"."status" = 'skipped') = ("security_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is not null) and ("security_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" is null or "security_email_deliveries"."skip_reason" in ('expired', 'change-not-supported'))

inbox_notifications_subject_check.name: inbox_notifications_subject_check
inbox_notifications_subject_check.value:
(("inbox_notifications"."subject_kind" is null and "inbox_notifications"."subject_value" is null)
        or ("inbox_notifications"."subject_kind" = 'task-key' and "inbox_notifications"."subject_value" ~ '^[A-Z]{2,5}-[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$')
        or ("inbox_notifications"."subject_kind" in ('task-id', 'space', 'list') and "inbox_notifications"."subject_value" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')) is true

inbox_notifications_time_check.name: inbox_notifications_time_check
inbox_notifications_time_check.value: "inbox_notifications"."updated_at" >= "inbox_notifications"."created_at" and ("inbox_notifications"."read_at" is null or "inbox_notifications"."read_at" >= "inbox_notifications"."created_at") and ("inbox_notifications"."archived_at" is null or "inbox_notifications"."archived_at" >= "inbox_notifications"."created_at")

notification_preferences_recipient_read.name: notification_preferences_recipient_read
notification_preferences_recipient_read.using: nullif(current_setting('app.organization_id', true), '') is not null and "notification_preferences"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.notification_recipient_id', true), '')::uuid

reminders_time_check.name: reminders_time_check
reminders_time_check.value: "reminders"."remind_at" > "reminders"."created_at" and ("reminders"."fired_at" is null or "reminders"."fired_at" >= "reminders"."remind_at") and ("reminders"."completed_at" is null or "reminders"."completed_at" >= coalesce("reminders"."fired_at", "reminders"."created_at"))
